Name: Garlic Bread Crop
Author: Crunch7
Description:
[code]﻿[/code]This mod adds a recipe and object for butter (renamed "buter" for compatibility with other mods), a garlic bread crop that produces raw garlic bread, a recipe to turn that raw garlic bread into cooked garlic bread. DISCLAIMER: This is my first mod, so it may not be "balanced" or may have some bugs. I don't recommend buying the crop until year two, unless you have garlic and milk.

Requirements:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿.

Installation:
1) Download the main file, "Garlic Bread Crop"
2) Extract contents to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

Recipes:
[code][spoiler]
Buter:
-Any type of milk.
Purchase recipe from Pierre (costs 175g)

Cooked Garlic Bread:
-1 Raw Garlic Bread
-2 butter
-2 cheese
-3 garlic
Purchase recipe from Gus (costs 3000g)
[/spoiler]
[/code]
